newsitem.title: USA: Justice Dept wants more data on Katz merger.
newsitem.headline: Justice Dept wants more data on Katz merger.

text.p: Evergreen Media Corp, Chancellor Broadcasting Co and Katz Media Group Inc said on Tuesday that the U.S. Department of Justice has requested that Evergreen provide additional information with respect to Evergreen's filing for the acquisition of Katz by Evergreen and Chancellor.

The company said in a press release that the request for additional information will extend the waiting period under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvement Act for ten calendar days following the date that Evergreen substantially complies with the request for additional information.

As previously reported, a jointly owned subsidiary of Evergreen and Chancellor began a cash tender offer to acquire any and all outstanding shares of common stock of Katz at a price of $11.00 per share. The companies said they expected to complete the deal during the third quarter.
The companies said that no purchase of Katz securities may be consummated until the waiting period expires or is terminated.
Evergreen said it intends to comply with the request for additional information as expeditiously as practicable.

Katz Media said it is the only full-service media representation firm in the United States serving multiple types of electronic media, representing radio and television stations, cable television systems and Internet media outlets. The company is exclusively retained by over 2,000 radio stations, 340 television stations and 1,500 cable systems to sell national spot advertising air time throughout the United States.
Chancellor and Evergreen own and operate radio stations across the United States.
